adjusted_metrics_unreconciled.reason: the supplied input does not establish whether adjusted metrics are reconciled to Ind AS

asset_quality_bucket.reason: GNPA is not disclosed for every FY observation

auditor_bucket.formula: clean_reputed: unqualified, no auditor change, no EOM; eom_only: EOM/CARO only and no change; unstable_or_repeated_eom: auditor change within 3 years or repeated EOM. A qualified/adverse/disclaimer opinion is a knockout rather than a score.
auditor_bucket.reason: it is not established whether the auditor changed within the last three years

auditor_or_cfo_exit_2y.reason: the supplied input does not establish whether the auditor or CFO resigned in the last two years

board_kmp_bucket.formula: independent_stable: independent-majority board and no KMP exit in 2 years; high_churn: >=2 KMP exits; else other

cash_runway_months.formula: post-issue cash and equivalents / average monthly operating cash burn
cash_runway_months.reason: the latest FY was not cash-consumptive, so runway is not a binding constraint

cfo_exempt.formula: cfo_pat_cumulative < 0 and (order book >= 2x revenue, or collections >= pre-sales) and receivable days up less than 15% YoY

cfo_pat_cumulative.formula: sum(CFO over the full FY observations) / sum(PAT over the same observations); a cumulative ratio, not the arithmetic mean of annual CFO/PAT ratios

contingent_liab_unquantified.reason: the supplied input does not establish whether any material contingent liability is unquantified

contribution_bucket.formula: expanding_2y_gt300bps: positive and up more than 300 bps two years running; positive_improving; positive_flat_or_falling; negative
contribution_bucket.reason: three FY observations of contribution margin are required

crar_buffer_pts.formula: CRAR (or Tier 1) minus the regulatory minimum, in percentage points
crar_buffer_pts.reason: neither CRAR nor Tier 1 is disclosed

eom_materiality.formula: low / medium / high by the size of the matter relative to net worth
eom_materiality.reason: the materiality of the emphasis-of-matter items is not established

ev_ebitda_mid_cycle_premium_pct.formula: second_multiple_premium_pct recomputed against mid-cycle (5-FY average) EBITDA
ev_ebitda_mid_cycle_premium_pct.reason: a mid-cycle EV/EBITDA needs 5 FY observations, a market cap and a balance sheet

gcp_amount.formula: the disclosed general corporate purposes amount; UNKNOWN when the RHP shows [●]
gcp_amount.reason: the general corporate purposes amount is shown as [●] in the RHP and is therefore undisclosed; the legal maximum is recorded separately and is NOT substituted for the actual amount

gcp_legal_max.reason: recorded separately from the disclosed GCP amount, per spec s10/s13

going_concern_uncertainty.reason: the supplied input does not establish whether going-concern uncertainty exists

industry_cagr_pct.formula: forward industry CAGR from the independent industry report in the RHP, %
industry_cagr_pct.reason: the industry CAGR is not scorable because its scope, forecast period, source is not recorded; spec s12 requires value, scope, forecast period and source together

leverage_bucket.formula: strong: D/E<0.5 and ICR>5; ok: D/E<1; stretched: 1<=D/E<=2; weak: D/E>2

litigation_bucket.formula: clean / minor_civil / criminal_or_regulatory across promoters, directors and the company

lockin_bucket.formula: intact: promoter lock-in in place and no early unlock of large pre-IPO holders; else weak

loss_narrowing_bucket.formula: two_years: operating loss as a share of revenue narrowed two consecutive years; one_year: the latest year only; widening: otherwise
loss_narrowing_bucket.reason: three FY observations of operating loss as a share of revenue are required

low_base_year.formula: earliest-year PAT margin < low_base_margin_ratio x latest-year PAT margin

margin_spike_pre_ipo.formula: EBITDA margin rose by more than margin_spike_bps in either of the last two FYs

margin_trend.formula: expanding: EBITDA and PAT margin both up each year; declining_or_loss: latest PAT<=0 or both margins down; volatile: direction flips with range >300 bps; else stable

margin_trend_5y_avg.formula: cyclical override: margin_trend computed on 5-FY average margins
margin_trend_5y_avg.reason: the cyclical profile requires 5 FY observations; 3 supplied

market_regime_variant.formula: hot when at least min_count of the last lookback_ipos listed above listing_gain_pct
market_regime_variant.reason: 0 recent listing gain observations available; the variant selects the subscription band table

net_debt_bucket.formula: net debt/equity trend and project-debt interest cover

net_worth_latest.formula: net worth of latest restated full FY (INR_CRORES)

nim_cost_income_bucket.formula: trend of NIM and cost-to-income across the FY observations
nim_cost_income_bucket.reason: NIM or cost-to-income is not disclosed for every FY observation

ofs_seller_bucket.formula: promoter_selling if any promoter/promoter-group seller sold >0; else pe_vc_exit if any PE/VC sells >=25% of its holding; else none_or_small

pat_latest.formula: PAT of latest restated full FY (INR_CRORES)

pb_roe_adjusted_premium_pct.formula: issuer P/B divided by the ROE-adjusted median VALID peer P/B - 1, x100
pb_roe_adjusted_premium_pct.reason: the ROE-adjusted P/B comparison needs issuer P/B, issuer ROE and peer P/B and ROE; no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

pe_premium_mid_cycle_pct.formula: pe_premium_pct recomputed against mid-cycle (5-FY average) earnings
pe_premium_mid_cycle_pct.reason: the cyclical profile needs 5 FY observations to form a mid-cycle multiple

pe_premium_pct.formula: (issue price / post-issue EPS) / (median VALID peer P/E) - 1, x100
pe_premium_pct.reason: no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

pe_promoter_sold_pct_combined.formula: (promoter + PE/VC shares sold) / (their listed pre-issue shares) x 100

peg.formula: post-issue P/E / PAT CAGR (2Y from 3 FY), %

pre_ipo_placement_bucket.formula: deep_discount_12m: any placement in the 12 months before the issue open at more than 25% below the issue price; none_or_near_ipo: none, or all within near_ipo_price_pct; else in_between

profit_declining.formula: PAT below the prior FY, or PAT CAGR below zero

promoter_ofs_pct_of_holding.formula: promoter shares sold / sum(pre-issue shares of promoter and promoter-group sellers) x 100

ps_premium_pct.formula: (market cap / revenue) vs the median VALID peer P/S - 1, x100
ps_premium_pct.reason: no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

regulatory_dependence.reason: the supplied input does not establish whether the business depends on a single licence or a controlled price

retail_or_nii_below_1x.formula: retail or NII subscription below 1.0x at close

revenue_cagr_3y_from_4fy.reason: 4 full FY observations are required for a 3-year CAGR; 3 supplied

roa_roe_peer_quartile.formula: issuer ROA/ROE versus the VALID peer quartiles
roa_roe_peer_quartile.reason: the peer-quartile comparison needs the issuer ROE and at least two VALID peer ROE observations; no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

roce_latest.formula: ROCE = EBIT / Capital Employed, where Capital Employed = total equity + total borrowings (RHP 'Basis for Offer Price' definitions); a disclosed ROCE overrides
roce_latest.reason: disclosed ROCE in the restated financials takes precedence over the computed value

rpt_pct_of_revenue_growth.formula: share of revenue growth attributable to related parties, %
rpt_pct_of_revenue_growth.reason: the related-party contribution to revenue growth is not disclosed

second_multiple_premium_pct.formula: issuer EV/EBITDA vs the median VALID peer EV/EBITDA; P/B if EBITDA is not meaningful
second_multiple_premium_pct.reason: no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

sector_ipo_relative.formula: post-issue P/E vs the median of the last 4 same-sector IPOs: cheaper below -band, richer above +band, else in_line
sector_ipo_relative.reason: no recent same-sector IPO valuations were supplied, so the relative test cannot be evaluated

top5_concentration_pct.formula: the higher of the top-5 customer and top-5 supplier concentration

use_of_proceeds_bucket.formula: blind_heavy: (gcp + unidentified acquisition)/fresh > 20%; else debt_heavy: debt repayment/fresh > 50%; else growth: (capex + R&D)/fresh >= growth_share_min_pct; else mixed_ok
use_of_proceeds_bucket.reason: the blind_heavy test ((GCP + unidentified acquisition)/fresh > 20%) cannot be evaluated because a GCP or unidentified-acquisition amount is undisclosed. The legal maximum is not substituted, and an undisclosed amount is not read as zero, because either would let a blind-heavy offer pass the test
